channel.title: 1bit.MONSTER — Blog
channel.description: How the 1-bit inference engine actually gets built — NPU, ROCm, kernels, formats.

item.title: Lemonade v11.7.0, and how we stay current with the SDK
item.description: The embedded Lemonade server core is re-vendored to v11.7.0: 14 backends (incl. the new TheNoise), register/options/stats/metrics endpoints live, and a repeatable re-vendor loop so every upstream release lands fast.

item.title: Two PCs, two GPUs, zero cloud
item.description: Two DeepSeek Harness agents on one LAN, both fed by 1bit.MONSTER: 35B at 166 tok/s on a Radeon 8060S, 8B at 96 tok/s on an RX 9070 XT, plus Qwen3-VL vision. Six engine bugs fixed along the way, with the methodology that caught them.

item.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B streams fully on the Ryzen AI NPU
item.description: AMD's official FastFlowLM numbers for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on the Ryzen AI NPU, decoded. 13.65 tok/s decode and 221.96 tok/s prefill on Kraken Point, verified against the official Qwen config, with our independent first pass at 75.65 tok/s via llama.cpp Vulkan on Strix Halo.

item.title: 37 FLM models, 209 xclbins, zero config files
item.description: AMD's entire pre-built NPU model zoo extracted from ROCm/FastFlowLM v0.9.46: all 37 FLM models and 209 xclbin bitstreams with zero config files, including Qwen3.5 Omni multi-modal C++ source and Qwen3.6-MoE-35B with 256 experts, auto-detected straight from the Q4NX header.

item.title: Zyphra family complete
item.description: All four Zyphra models at 1BP, converted and validated end to end on the ZINC GPU: Zamba2 1.2B, 2.7B and 7B (Mamba2-hybrid) plus ZR1-1.5B reasoning, 26 tok/s on Strix Halo. Two architectures, one engine.

item.title: One binary, all formats
item.description: Ternary and binary inference on NPU and GPU from a single engine: Q1_0, TQ1, TQ2, IQ1_S/M and BitNet GGUF on HIP, Vulkan and XDNA 2, verified exact on real Strix Halo hardware, in 4,200 lines across 31 files.

item.title: Unsloth for AMD
item.description: Training, fine-tuning and RL land on Radeon, Instinct and Ryzen AI. Native AMD support, stated plainly: 2x faster, 70% less VRAM, runs in 3GB. Complementary to our inference side.

item.title: TokenRouter: token-level multi-backend inference
item.description: Open-source token-level routing for multi-backend LLM inference on AMD Strix Halo. NPU drafts, GPU verifies, and real logprobs ride on the wire.

item.title: What the Ryzen AI Halo reviews didn't tell you
item.description: Strix Halo ships a 50 TOPS NPU and the reviews quote it like a fact. AMD's FLM runtime delivers 11 tok/s, ROCm delivers 41 tok/s, and we drive the same NPU through a fused-layer engine. A review of the reviews, with the unsourced throughput figures quarantined.

item.title: DSpark speculative decoding, disproven
item.description: DSpark was projected to hit 572 tok/s on Strix Halo. End-to-end measurement on the NPU disproved it: 0.1 to 0.2 tok/s at 0% draft acceptance. How and why, what it would take to fix, and why these figures are historical and unsourced.

item.title: Three bugs that broke 97 tok/s
item.description: The 97 tok/s number was real. The output behind it never was. Three silent bugs, LM head substitution, weight transpose, and activation clipping, produced garbage at full speed. The classic story of a fast number with wrong output, and the discipline of not shipping it.

item.title: One engine. Every model. Any chip.
item.description: A single tiny C++ binary auto-detects 73+ models across six backends, from NPU to CPU, from one Q4NX header parse. No per-backend builds, no per-model config.

item.title: 244 to 3.4 ms/tok: the NPU optimization sprint
item.description: Seven engine versions in four days took NPU inference from 1,930 ms/tok to 3.4 ms/tok, a 72x speedup through batch decode, fused dispatch, and INT8 GEMM. The record of that sprint, with the throughput figures historical and unsourced.

item.title: 50 TOPS on a laptop
item.description: Benchmarking the XDNA 2 NPU: historical NPU benchmark notes from the first month of the project. Figures quarantined as unsourced.

item.title: The fused layer engine
item.description: How QKV, attention and FFN combine into a single NPU dispatch, eliminating five of every six per-layer xclbin calls. Throughput here is historical and unsourced.

item.title: I reverse-engineered AMD's NPU stack in 4 days
item.description: A laptop, a disassembler and no docs: a 50 TOPS XDNA 2 NPU locked behind 22 proprietary libraries and 209 xclbins, replaced with open C++ in four days. The hero story, with the honest corrections.

item.title: 1bit Coding Agent released
item.description: A pi.dev-compatible coding agent CLI with 7 commands, NPU-native inference, package management, extensions, skills, themes and a systemd service, shipping in the 1bit MONSTER monorepo.

item.title: NPU v12: M=32 batch decode at 97 tok/s
item.description: A 24x speedup in one session, from 244 to 10 ms/tok, beating FLM Kraken Point by 46%. OpenMP attention plus LM head. Full C++23, zero Python.

item.title: Historical benchmark: both lanes green
item.description: An early local run with one Lemonade endpoint over two compute lanes, iGPU llama.cpp ROCm plus NPU FLM, on Linux. Historical local run, kept for the record.
